channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

item.title: March to Supreme Court: Who is attending, why the CJI declined, and what Delhi curbs look like on day three
item.description: The Opposition INDIA bloc seeks to submit a memorandum to Chief Justice of India Surya Kant over alleged ‘vote chori’ (theft), but the CJI has declined to meet the Congress leader.

item.title: ‘Upload whatever they give’: AEROs allege pressure to clear SIR notices without hearings
Anti-CEC row LIVE: Opposition leaders set to march to Supreme Court; security beefed up outside Parliament Street police station
item.description: Sources said CJI Surya Kant declined a request by Rahul Gandhi for a meeting as the issues were already sub judice; Delhi HC agrees to hear plea challenging Jantar Mantar closure tomorrow

item.title: 16 people drowned to death in Bihar on the first day of Dussehra festival
item.description: According to police officials, most of the death reports from drowning have come from the districts of Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga and Sitamarhi.

item.title: Visakhapatnam’s air was worse than ‘satisfactory’ on 259 of 382 days; data show winter brings the worst
item.description: All 10 monitoring stations in Visakhapatnam breached the annual PM10 limit over 12 months; the city’s bowl-shaped terrain and winter temperature inversion trap pollutants, an APPCB scientist says

item.title: Security beefed up outside Parliament Street police station ahead of CJP leaders visit for fresh Jantar Mantar protest date
item.description: CJP co-convenor Ashutosh Ranka says party will approach Delhi Police for permission to protest at Jantar Mantar, two days after demonstrations were stopped.

item.title: Appointments in Election Commission of India | Explained
item.description: The appointment is important as the two Election Commissioners S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had written to Cabinet Secretary on how files of the ECI IT department head Dr Seema Khanna not being routed through Mr. Kumar, who was a seasoned officer, was a violation

item.title: INS Mangrol, anti-submarine warfare shallow water craft, inducted into Navy
item.description: Built with over 80% indigenous content, Mangrol reflects the country’s growing capabilities in warship construction and the integration of indigenous weapons and sensors

item.title: The caste thread travels overseas
item.description: Dalit students studying abroad hope to escape oppressive caste hierarchies, only to find that the dominant-caste diaspora has exported its prejudice into classrooms and social settings across borders, reports Radheshyam Jadhav

item.title: Dalit youth alleges loss of job in U.K. due to caste discrimination by Pune college

item.description: The incident took place on October 8 at the Supreme Court Metro station, where the deceased, Pawan Sharma, allegedly got into an altercation with the two accused, identified as Sanjay Pratap Singh and his son Sidharth Singh, according to the FIR

item.title: Invasive species may be the wrong enemy in a changing subcontinent
item.description: It is easier to count acres of invasive alien species removed than to measure the shifts in moisture regimes or soil chemistry that aided their growth

item.title: Gehlot cautions Congress leaders about ‘misuse’ of police, administration by BJP in Rajasthan Panchayat polls
item.description: The Panchayati Raj polls in Rajasthan will be held in four phases from October 22 to November 16

item.title: Vijay urges Prime Minister Modi to sanction Metro Rail from Hosur to Bommasandra
item.description: The CM says the inter-State link will benefit both T.N. and Karnataka. He also urges Modi to reconsider Metro Rail projects in Coimbatore and Madurai in view of the future development and economic growth of T.N.’s western and southern regions

item.title: Policy, production concerns dominate KPA annual media briefing
item.description: UPASI points out a critical lack of clarity in the draft Western Ghats Ecologically Sensitive Area (ESA) notification. While the preamble states that land can be used for agricultural purposes, this must be explicitly codified into the operative part of the notification, it insists

item.title: Wayanad bus accident: Two dead, several injured as Munnar tour vehicle overturns
item.description: The vehicle was carrying a party of post graduate students from Mandya University in Karnataka

item.title: ₹45 lakh for old ₹1 note: Hyderabad cyber fraud probe uncovers ₹70 crore mule account network

item.title: Telangana government to reconsider charges of Hyderabad Metro-Telangana RTC common mobility card
item.description: The monthly pass costs ₹8,500 including Hyderabad Metro Rail’s share ₹7,000 and TGSRTC’s share of ₹1,500.

item.title: New Deputy Election Commissioner appointed in ECI amid concerns over work hierarchy
item.description: Prakash Rajpurohit fills the vacancy left by Sanjay Kumar’s premature repatriation, amid concerns raised by Election Commissioners S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi over IT department files not being routed through him

item.title: Of being young at heart: A platform for elderly in Thiruvananthapuram to rediscover life
item.description: Envisioned as a platform for senior citizens and those in their 50s, Young at Heart hopes to bring people together to rediscover life’s little pleasures — new friendships, new learning experiences, evenings out, and a little fun and frolic

item.description: The Shipping Minister further said search-and-rescue operations were actively underway by the local Coast Guard

item.title: Dipke’s family claims Delhi police delayed release, causing him to miss grandmother's funeral

item.title: Amid modernisation in railways, porters face shrinking income, bleak future
item.description: The newer infrastructure developed by the Railways over the past 15-years, including lift and escalators, combined with wheeled suitcases, has practically wiped out our job, says a porter in U.P.

item.title: Noted architect N.M. Salim passes away
item.description: Salim was active in the architecture field for over five decades, playing a key role in transforming the face of urban centres in Keralam and other South Indian States

item.title: Heavy rain, thunderstorms lash Delhi; IMD issues 'red' alert

item.description: Congress leaders Mallikarjun Kharge and Rahul Gandhi had written to the CJI and were scheduled to meet him between 4 p.m. and 5 p.m. on Monday (October 12, 2026).
